reasons.claim: 1 eligible species within 250 m: Alectoria sarmentosa (VU lichen, site-bound, forest-associated), 180 m away, 2025 record, 10 m uncertainty. Its listed threats include lack of continuity forest and large/old trees and changed stand structure.
Supporting: 3 site-bound forest NT species within 250 m (Lobaria pulmonaria, Pelloporus leporinus, Phellinidium ferrugineofuscum, 2025 records), plus the mobile NT bird Picoides tridactylus (2026).
No completed felling overlaps the 8.15 ha polygon, so not ALREADY_FELLED.
Effort is adequate (93rd percentile). There are 21 records within 250 m and none inside the polygon.

uncertainties: Only one eligible record, a single Alectoria sarmentosa observation 180 m from the edge. Its presence in the stand itself is unknown.
One record was dropped for coordinate uncertainty.
not_established: Presence or absence of species inside the polygon (no records inside, which is not absence).
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: Human reviewer should check the 2025 records against the polygon and stand, and consider a field inventory before felling starts.
